description: This file defines the TaxClass entity class within a Java-based e-commerce platform. It models tax classification data and relationships to products, tax rates, and merchant stores, using JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Entity class representing a tax classification, including fields for ID, code, title, related products, merchant store, and tax rates, with JPA annotations for persistence.

methods.name: TaxClass(String code)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tax class with a specific code, setting the title to the same value.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the tax class.

methods.name: setId(Long id)
methods.description: Sets the unique ID of the tax class.

methods.name: getTitle()
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the tax class.

methods.name: setTitle(String title)
methods.description: Sets the title for the tax class.

methods.name: getCode()
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier of the tax class.

methods.name: setCode(String code)
methods.description: Assigns a code identifier to the tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRates()
methods.description: Returns the list of tax rates associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setTaxRates(List<TaxRate> taxRates)
methods.description: Sets the list of tax rates for this tax class.

methods.name: getMerchantStore()
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setMerchantStore(MerchantStore merchantStore)
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this tax class.
